title: The Living Heritage Exhibit
learning_focus: Term synthesis: narrative and informational texts, visual and multimedia meaning, cultural appropriateness, grammar, summary, and audience.
story_premise: The Living Library opens a regional exhibit, but each item must have a clear source, purpose, audience, and permission status before the doors open.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Term synthesis: narrative and informational texts, visual and multimedia meaning, cultural appropriateness, grammar, summary, and audience.
